dc_eval_cbrn.quote:
human expert performance on BioLP-Bench is
38.4% and 22.1% on VCT, so both Grok 4 API and Grok 4 Web achieve superhuman performance
on identifying issues in biological protocols and wetlab virology experiments.
dc_eval_cbrn.note: Scores on BioLP-Bench, VCT, WMDP Bio/Chem.

dc_eval_cyber.quote:
third-party testing by the UK AI Security
Institute (AISI) shows that Grok 4’s end-to-end offensive cyber capabilities remain below the level
of a human professional.

dc_eval_autonomy.note: Only 'autonomously carrying out cyberattacks', which is cyber by boundary rule; no replication/AI R&D/self-improvement evaluated.

dc_eval_persuasion.quote:
For the persuasion evaluation, we
report the proportion of games the model was able to manipulate a non-reasoning version of Grok
3 Mini.

dc_eval_scheming.quote:
We measure how deceptive the model is by the rate at which the model lies, i.e.,
knowingly makes false statements intended to be received as true.
dc_eval_scheming.note: Deception framed as controllability / loss-of-control propensity; MASK dishonesty rate 0.43.

framework_threshold.quote:
Following our Risk Management Framework (RMF), we aim to reduce the risk of severe, large-scale
harms to people, property, and society from AI.
framework_threshold.note: RMF named; 'low risk' judgement is not placed against a named threshold or level.

the dual-use capabilities of our models on providing chemical and biological uplift

safeguards_training.quote:
on top of our safety training, we have implemented a system prompt that provides
additional mitigations

safeguards_runtime.quote:
We also employ model-based filters for both Grok 4 API and Grok 4 Web,
which reject classes of harmful requests

safeguards_access.note: No access restriction tied to safety; Web not accepting custom system prompts is product design, not risk-tied access.
